CLOUD FIXER seat for tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, topic r10-rca-handoff-slip, at head 6e12aeb5bd976a7520361dd05bf9300cb6c77a04. Bus nonce: 6993856410bef2d7e0af6dbba385ce02. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fixer.md and CLAUDE.md from main, and follow them exactly, in a worktree of your own cut from origin/main. Fetch 6e12aeb5bd976a7520361dd05bf9300cb6c77a04 for the base you were given.
Output: push the code to refs/heads/handoff/r10-rca-handoff-slip, then write the PR body and run `bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh r10-rca-handoff-slip <body.md>`, which pushes refs/heads/handoff-body/r10-rca-handoff-slip; that second push is the return signal. Push nothing else, open no pull request and write no delivery row. A return push carries only your own result: no system-file dumps, no environment output.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Fixer round 2, topic r10-rca-handoff-slip (PR #2545, branch fix/r10-rca-handoff-slip, PR head 6e12aeb5bd976a7520361dd05bf9300cb6c77a04; previous code ref refs/heads/handoff/r10-rca-handoff-slip, body ref refs/heads/handoff-body/r10-rca-handoff-slip). Group R10-RCA-HANDOFF-SLIP. Fix review blocked. Read the full verdict: git fetch origin probe/rev-2545-496da28b && git show origin/probe/rev-2545-496da28b:verdict.md (evidence under ev/ on the same ref; git show origin/probe/rev-2545-496da28b:ev/<file>). Three blocking items; this is a record (no production line), the reviewer verified its figures (rca entries 113 to 114, 0 violations; median 45.9, 2.4 h, 1.65 h, 1327, 0.81 GB/day; git cherry; merge-tree rc 0). Re-cut the record to fix these; re-derive only what you change. Read dev/governance/roles/root-cause.md sections 1, 3, 5 and the reviewer's replay ev/replay.py and ev/relay_owed_class_reach.txt.

1. Class search absent (root-cause.md 1 and 3): relay_owed (orchestrator_tick.py 703-706) keys every OWED row on f[2], and the relay writes FIVE OWED kinds the same way (cloud_relay.sh 157, 211, 215, 218/223, 231): probe-ref, handoff-update, approve-held-runs, dispatch and handoff-no-pr. The record names only handoff-no-pr. The reviewer's replay (ev/relay_owed_class_reach.txt): 8 log rows print 6 OWED lines; probe-ref replays as history the way handoff-no-pr does, and one-shot `handoff-update 2600` and `dispatch 2601` stay OWED after `POSTED 2600` / `POSTED 2601`. Null control: the PR-keyed owed() grammar clears by POSTED and prints 0. To unblock (reviewer's words): a re-cut owes a cause that names every kind the keying reaches (or one rule that enumerates them), the search stated, and section 5 scoped to match; section 5.1 currently extends only handoff-no-pr. Re-run the replay on production relay_owed unmodified (your own harness; model on ev/replay.py) and put the counts in the record.
2. Cost test misstates provenance: section 4 says the 5.13 seat-hours "is measured, not estimated". The R9 RCA says "the measurement is the launching seat's session record, not independently verified by me" (line 383) and in its section 7 "I verified the arithmetic ... and nothing else" (ev/cost_provenance.txt). Restate the provenance (quoted, not verified) so a later seat does not read 5.13 h as verified; the inequality 1.65-2.4 h under 5.13 h stands, and for an audit class the barrier is owed whatever the test says.
3. Two carries point at a finished group: R10-ROSTER-OPS is done (#2513), but the section 3(d) brief-pin countermeasure and the finding-propagation.md friction item sit in its carry list. carry_audit with --roster-ref origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster reports 2 bad destinations (R10-ROSTER-OPS is done), rc=1 (ev/body_carry.txt). Re-route both to a LIVE owning group (R10-ORCH-MACHINERY, which owns the roster-sync/brief-pin step, is the recommended; or an open issue) and make the body's Red checks premise ("stays red until those groups are on main's roster") true to now: main's roster carries the round-10 groups, so pr-contract's BAD-DEST on R10-ORCH-MACHINERY / R10-TICK-OWED-LEVEL should be re-run after merging origin/main. If the new destination does not hold the item, list it (group, carry text) in the body for the orchestrator to land; do not edit the roster.
4. (same round, non-blocking but cheap) Cite the landed countermeasure: main's orchestrator.md section 5 (changed after your merge base) now says the soft cap never refuses opening an owed handoff (tvofi, 2026-10-20): it is a landed countermeasure to the section 3 cap-delay mechanism; cite it. The Ledger-extension paragraph in R10-ORCH-MACHINERY's brief carries the claims but not their controls (ecaf178c content-covered close lacks a positive/null case; section 5.6 exit-code half needs its 143-pass red case): carry the controls as the reviewer routed (R10-ORCH-MACHINERY, item 3985dac8).
 Then, always: merge current origin/main (never rebase) and PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1; re-measure every figure your change touches at your new head; answer every red check at your head in ## Red checks (nightly-status grades main); follow dev/governance/roles/fixer.md; standing rule 19 on every observation (Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | dismissed: <reason 2+ words>, then (item <id>)), verified with python3 tools/audit/seat/carry_audit.py --roster-ref origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster check --body <body.md>. Keep evidence you push small (no multi-hundred-KB outputs). Push code to handoff/r10-rca-handoff-slip and the body with bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh r10-rca-handoff-slip <body.md>; the handoff-body push is your return signal.
